$comment: T-3578: who reads each jaunt script, and how. tools/narrate_jaunts.mjs voices every script of the jaunts listed here whose words (or voice) changed since it was last voiced, and only those. A narrator script (a jaunt's opening, its endings, any stop with no host) is voiced once for each narrator in `narrators`, or for the narrators a jaunt entry names ({id, narrators}: the owner, 2026-11-19, T-3696, new jaunts in the Cultivated Essayist only, the Storyteller later); visitors choose which they hear in Settings › Sound, and `essayist` is the default (owner, 2026-11-13). A stop is read by its first host, by person id, in `voices`. A voice is an ElevenLabs voice id or the exact name of one of the owner's voices; null means not chosen yet, and those scripts are skipped (and listed in the run's report). docs/AUDIO.md § Narration. Each script is performed from its direction in data/narration/direction/<jaunt>.json (the same words with ElevenLabs v3 audio tags and pauses; owner, 2026-11-15), so the model is eleven_v3, whose stability takes 0 (creative), 0.5 (natural) or 1 (robust). A run voices the jaunts in this list's order (the narration budget plan's) up to max_chars_per_run and what the ElevenLabs quota has left above quota_reserve; the rest waits for the next run (T-3696).
